content:
Nikhil Rao: Hi team, first-day snag. Okta accepted my work account but I still see a welcome 1Password invite at nikhil.rao.personal@gmail.com and my Google Drive shortcuts are missing. Also when I try to enroll a passkey on my Mac it shows "Use Windows Hello" and fails. Anyone recognize this mix?
People Ops - Hana: Welcome, Nikhil! :wave: DMing you to confirm the personal email so we can remove it from HR and resend. We sometimes get extras if folks clicked a phone link.
IT Support: Created ticket ONB-11422. Quick checks: which browser and did you click the invite link from phone or desktop?
Nikhil Rao: macOS Ventura 13.6, Chrome 121. Clicked the welcome link on my phone earlier.
Maria (IT): Thanks. Two separate issues likely: (1) phone acceptance tied an Apple iCloud/passkey to your personal AppleID causing the passkey flow to fail; (2) People Ops had the personal email on file so the 1Password invite went there. Hana will resend.
Maria (IT): For Mac enroll steps that avoid Windows Hello prompt: install Okta Verify on phone OR in Okta choose "Set up authenticator app" and use the QR/TOTP flow. For passkeys try System Settings -> Passwords -> Add Passkey (native path) rather than the browser flow.
DevEx - Priya: For Drive/team access, group sync from Google Workspace -> Okta -> 1Password can lag. I can trigger a resync if Maria confirms identity cleanup. Command I run is: `/provisioning resync nikhil.rao` (admin).
helpdesk-bot: [ONB-11422] Ticket created and assigned to Maria (IT).
People Ops - Hana: Removed personal email at 1977654360 and resent 1Password invite to nikhil@redwood.com. LMK if it doesn't land.
Nikhil Rao: Got the 1Password invite to my work email. Followed Maria's passkey steps and enrolled a passkey at 1977654410. Still no Drive shortcuts.
DevEx - Priya: Kicked resync at 1977654420. Should appear within a few minutes; if not I'll check SCIM logs.
helpdesk-bot: [ONB-11422] Provisioning resync requested by DevEx - Priya.
Nikhil Rao: Drive shortcuts appeared at 1977654505. Everything working now — Okta, passkey, 1Password, Drive. Thanks for the quick help!
IT Support: Marking ONB-11422 resolved. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
